about: Every host check that only observes, reports or runs in shadow, and every rule the rule map marks prose or partly, with the date by which the host decides it: enforce, retired (moved to PLAYBOOK guidance) or extend (once, with a reason). decideBy is at most 14 days after since. The rule map lives in bee-scouts (templates/rule_map.json) and carries no lifecycle yet, so the lifecycles of its prose and partly rules are kept here under rules. Read by scripts/rule_lifecycle.py.

lifecycle.check: each runner record's verified_by stamp, mode observe; would_block is counted, nothing is blocked
lifecycle.metric: would_block records among the kept runner records, and fixture false positives (base_check --self-test)

lifecycle.check: what followed a stop on a rule within 24 hours: re-attempt, claim or reroute
lifecycle.metric: after-stop findings a day per agent; a 0 for 7 days retires it to the guard, a finding a day makes it a stop

lifecycle.check: receipts, escalation receivers, step-repair counters and LESSONS buckets
lifecycle.metric: problems per live run, fixed-verified receipts written

lifecycle.check: kept and rejected rules against the judgement files they cite; honest-failure rows
lifecycle.metric: problems per live run and kept rules with a wrong citation

lifecycle.check: the watchdog's findings on each agent repository, report-only; observing since 15 Nov 2026
lifecycle.metric: open findings older than 72 h per agent, and findings with no repair after 24 h

lifecycle.check: repeats keyed on play or tool and normalised cause, from LESSONS.md, runner records and research receipts
lifecycle.metric: dispatches that would be held per day, and held keys a later pass shows were wrong

lifecycle.check: a tool that failed 3+ times on a missing file no commit ever added; hostLimit when the kind was never committed
lifecycle.metric: tools flagged, and flagged tools whose file later landed

lifecycle.check: every prose or partly rule and every shadow check carries a lifecycle that ends within 14 days
lifecycle.metric: problems per live run

lifecycle.check: a Done build note needs a tools/ change in its step and every tools/<name> it names
lifecycle.metric: Done build notes a day with no tools/ change, per agent

lifecycle.check: every hivemindos.app link the host writes matches a registered shape, and one sample a shape answers
lifecycle.metric: unregistered shapes and dead shapes per daily run

lifecycle.check: how many of 20 fixed-seed small breaks a tool's own self_test.py catches
lifecycle.metric: k/n per tool on green records; tools at 0/n

lifecycle.check: every Python file under tools/ in the five agent repositories compiles at HEAD, frozen tools included; compile() only, nothing is run
lifecycle.metric: broken files per run; 0 on the decide-by date makes it a failing step

lifecycle.check: every workflow with a schedule ran within its period plus a 12-hour grace, by the Actions API; a workflow with no schedule is not checked
lifecycle.metric: late and late_never_ran schedules per run
